name: AlertDialog
description: Modal confirmation dialog that interrupts the user and waits for a response.

dos: Use it only when the action requires an explicit response: confirm or cancel.
Always include a Title: it is announced on open and gives the dialog its accessible name.
Make Action look clearly different from Cancel (in the design: solid red versus soft gray).
If there is no Description, remove the part and pass aria-describedby={undefined} to Content.
Write Title and Action with a concrete verb: "Revoke access", not "OK".

donts.case: Content with a form, images or information that does not require a response
donts.why: They look identical; the difference is semantic and behavioral. AlertDialog is only for confirmations.

donts.case: Notifying about something without asking for a decision
donts.useInstead: A non-modal message (Callout or Toast, depending on the system)
donts.why: A modal dialog interrupts; it should not be used to inform.

donts.case: Giving Action and Cancel the same visual weight
donts.why: The documentation asks that they be distinguishable at a glance.

related.difference: Same appearance, different semantics and behavior; for content that is not a confirmation.
Cancel and Action wrap a control of this type.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Belongs to Root.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled. Belongs to Root.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called on open or close. Belongs to Root.

props.name: size
props.description: Dialog scale: controls padding, radius, typography and button size. In code it accepts responsive values. In Figma the default value carries the ✦ mark ("3 ✦"). Belongs to Content.

props.name: inset
props.description: Design only: with true, the body slot content takes the full width, without the dialog's horizontal padding. It is not a Radix prop: in code it is solved with the content's own layout.

props.name: title
props.description: Title text. Announced when the dialog opens.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text. If not shown, remove the part and pass aria-describedby={undefined} to Content.

props.name: children
props.description: Free content between the description and the buttons (body slot).

props.name: width
props.description: Width. Accepts responsive values. Belongs to Content.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Minimum width. Accepts responsive values. Belongs to Content.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum width. Accepts responsive values. Belongs to Content.

props.name: height
props.description: Height. Accepts responsive values. Belongs to Content.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum height. Accepts responsive values. Belongs to Content.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height. Accepts responsive values. Belongs to Content. The design caps it at 690px.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Delegates Content's root element to its child. Belongs to Content.

controlled.name: open
controlled.description: The dialog is visible: focus is trapped inside and the rest of the page is not interactive.
controlled.aria: role='alertdialog'; Title and Description are announced on open

root.description: Design frame: leaves 16px (spacing.4) around the dialog and hosts the backdrop. In code it is provided by AlertDialog itself and Content's centered position.

backdrop.description: Layer that dims the page. Only shown in Figma if backdrop=true.

content.description: Dialog surface: background, 1px border, radius and shadow. Receives the ref and the alertdialog role.

title.description: Accessible title, announced on open. Based on Heading.

description.description: Accessible description, optional. Based on Text.

body.description: Slot for free content. The blue dashed rectangle in the design is only a placeholder: it is not implemented.

figmaToggle.note: Only exists with insetContent=false; with insetContent=true the slot is always present.

footer.description: Row of actions, aligned to the end.

cancel.description: Wraps the control that closes the dialog without confirming.

action.description: Wraps the control that closes the dialog and confirms the action.

codeParts.name: AlertDialog.Root
codeParts.description: Contains all the parts. No visual representation.

codeParts.name: AlertDialog.Trigger
codeParts.description: Wraps the control that opens the dialog.

codeParts.name: AlertDialog.Content
codeParts.description: Dialog body (anatomy.content). Receives the size and width props.

modes.fill: Content takes the available width up to maxWidth.
modes.fixed: In Figma, the frame measures 300 / 432 / 432 / 482 px for size 1 / 2 / 3 / 4, including 16px of margin on each side: the dialog measures 268 / 400 / 400 / 450 px.

width.note: maxWidth 600px by default in code and in the design. The design also caps the height at 690px, with internal vertical scroll.

events.name: onOpenChange
events.trigger: Open or close: Trigger, Action, Cancel or Esc

events.name: onEscapeKeyDown
events.trigger: Esc key with the dialog open

events.name: onOpenAutoFocus
events.trigger: On open, when focus enters Content

events.name: onCloseAutoFocus
events.trigger: On close, when focus returns to the Trigger

a11y.role: alertdialog (WAI-ARIA Alert and Message Dialogs pattern)
a11y.name: Title names the dialog and Description describes it; both are announced on open.
keyboard: Space / Enter — open or close the dialog from the Trigger
Tab / Shift+Tab — move focus to the next or previous focusable element inside the dialog (focus is trapped)
Esc — closes the dialog and returns focus to the Trigger
a11y.focusIndicator: Not defined in this Figma node: add the focus state for Cancel and Action.
a11y.minTarget: 24px buttons (size 1) meet 24x24px (WCAG 2.5.8); 32px and 40px for the rest.
a11y.contrastNote: Action: white on colors.semantic.error.9 = 3.91:1, below 4.5:1 (AA normal text). Cancel: 5.22:1. Title and Description on panel.solid: 16.39:1.

responsive.change: size accepts responsive values in code; the design only defines the four scales.

cases: On open, focus enters the dialog and is trapped
Esc closes and returns focus to the Trigger
Title and Description are associated with the dialog
Without Description and with aria-describedby={undefined}, the dialog declares no description
Action and Cancel close the dialog
The four size scales match the design

needsReview: props.open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange: they do not appear on the Radix Themes page consulted; included because they are the usual Root props. Verify.
Close behavior on outside click and initial focus on Cancel: not confirmed in the documentation consulted.
props.children: the exact name of the Figma property ("content1") is the one exposed by the MCP; confirm whether it is an instance swap or a slot.
props.title: the Title text is an override of the nested Heading, not a component property.
props.inset: design-only; confirm how you solve it in code.
anatomy.cancel / action: required comes from the design (they always appear); the documentation does not require it.
Hover, focus-visible and active states of Cancel and Action: not in this node.
The inset=true variant in sizes 1, 2 and 4 was not inspected: the same structure as size 3 is assumed.
Figma includes the variable Shadows/shadow-5, but none of the inspected variants uses it.
tokens.policy.forbidden is empty: the Radix file uses scales (Colors/Neutral/Neutral Alpha/3) without separating primitives from semantics.
Content's 1px border has no variable in Figma.
